options.name: accelerated_failback
options.description: If set to C(true), SyncIQ will perform failback configuration tasks during the next job run, rather than waiting to perform those tasks during the failback process. Performing these tasks ahead of time will increase the speed of failback operations. It defaults to C(true), if not specified.

options.name: action
options.description: Indicates type of replication action to be performed on the source.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: api_user
options.description: username of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the policy.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Indicates whether policy is enabled or disabled.

options.name: job_delay
options.description: If I(run_job) is set to C(when-source-modified), I(job_delay) is the duration to wait before triggering a job once there is modification on source.

options.name: job_delay_unit
options.description: Unit for I(job_delay).

options.name: job_params
options.description: Specifies the parameters to create a job on SyncIQ policy.

options.name: new_policy_name
options.description: The new name of the policy while renaming an existing policy. I(policy_name) or I(policy_id) is required together with I(new_policy_name).

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: policy_id
options.description: The I(policy_id) is auto generated at the time of creation. For get/modify operations either I(policy_name) or I(policy_id) is needed. Parameters I(policy_name) and I(policy_id) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: policy_name
options.description: The name of the policy. Required at the time of policy creation, for the rest of the operations either I(policy_name) or I(policy_id) is required.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: restrict_target_network
options.description: If set to C(true) then replication policies will connect only to nodes in the specified SmartConnect zone. If set to C(false), replication policies are not restricted to specific nodes on the target cluster.

options.name: rpo_alert
options.description: If I(run_job) is set to C(on-schedule) it is set to time/date, an alert is created if the specified RPO for this policy is exceeded. The default value is 0, which will not generate RPO alerts.

options.name: rpo_alert_unit
options.description: Unit for I(rpo_alert).

options.name: run_job
options.description: Types of scheduling a job on the policy.

options.name: schedule
options.description: Schedule set when I(run_policy) is C(on-schedule). It must be in isidate format. If the format is not proper an error will be thrown.

options.name: skip_when_source_unmodified
options.description: If true and schedule is set , the policy will not run if no changes have been made to the contents of the source directory since the last job successfully completed. Option modifiable when I(run_job) is C(on-schedule).

options.name: snapshot_sync_pattern
options.description: The naming pattern that a snapshot must match to trigger a sync when the schedule is C(when-snapshot-taken).

options.name: source_cluster
options.description: Defines the details of I(source_cluster).

options.name: state
options.description: The state option is used to determine whether the policy exists or not.

options.name: target_cluster
options.description: Details of the target cluster.

options.name: target_compare_initial_sync
options.description: If set to C(true), the initial sync will compare data between source and target to avoid re-transferring data that already exists at the target. This can significantly reduce initial sync time if the target already contains some or all of the source data. If set to C(false), the initial sync will transfer all source data to the target without comparison. It defaults to C(false), if not specified.

options.name: target_snapshot
options.description: Details of snapshots to be created at the target.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
